scope: A small, fresh transfer probe for general English rewriting across explanation, operational instruction, and personal reflection. It cannot establish general superiority or detector robustness.
provenance: Known AI-generated synthetic source, written in this evaluation subagent session.
truth_scope: All people, organizations, events, situations, and first-person memories are fictional. This is neither human-authored ground truth nor evidence about a real person or event.
selection_rule: Create exactly three realistic synthetic English cases of 140-200 whitespace-delimited words, one per chosen genre. Choose for distinct voice and semantic/speech-act demands, never by measured or imagined detector difficulty. No source substitution, exclusion, or score-based edits after freeze.
evaluation_order: Receive anonymous baseline and prototype candidates after prototype freeze.
Verify source hashes and evaluate every candidate against all source constraints before viewing scores or method identities.
Record source fidelity, speech-act fidelity, voice appropriateness, naturalness, clarity, and pairwise reader preference with exact passage evidence.
Lock qualitative decisions before identity and detector-score disclosure.
Interpret later score feedback as experimental model response, separately from reader quality and known AI provenance.

evaluation_criteria.fidelity_gate: Every factual proposition, uncertainty, logical distinction, assignment of responsibility, deadline, permission, instruction strength, and unresolved outcome must survive. Flag omissions and inventions regardless of fluency.
evaluation_criteria.reader_preference: Choose the version that best serves its audience with clear, idiomatic, sustained voice and appropriate rhythm. A tie is allowed. Do not reward novelty, informality, detail, or length by itself.
evaluation_criteria.claim_boundary: Report these three cases individually and in aggregate without extrapolating to natural human writing, other genres, or population accuracy.
evaluation_criteria.detector_boundary: Detector percentages are not votes on prose quality or verified authorship; all original sources are known AI-generated.
